name: Article 2, § 1; Regulation (EU) 2021/1057; Article 12b, after § 8 – 4
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council RESTORE – Regional Emergency Support to Reconstruction amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1058 and Regulation (EU) 2021/1057
part_text: 8a. The ESF+ resources used for the purposes of this regulation should subsequently be offset by means of transfers of equal amounts from titles 12, security, and 13, defence, of the EU budget.
